decisions.reason: The garage door operator line is a heavily invested, publicly showcased pillar of the firm's one-source garage door offering, so management will keep it despite missing recent web evidence and attribute any weakness to temporary market conditions.

The remote-controlled operator rounds out the committed operator line, and dropping it would call earlier investment decisions into question, though its low visibility makes quiet replacement somewhat more plausible.
Glazed industrial sectional doors belong to the core industrial range the firm has publicly committed to, so it persists with them and treats soft results as cyclical rather than structural.
The insulated glazed variant fits the announced thermal and energy-efficiency direction and shares tooling with the industrial door family, which reinforces the commitment to keep it.
Having been featured prominently on its own page, this door carries visible sunk development and marketing costs that management will want to justify by continuing it.
